bank-fanout-02.sql:
WITH usd_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, account_type
    FROM bank.accounts
    WHERE currency = 'USD'
),

balances AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_type,
        SUM(db.balance) AS ending_balance
    FROM bank.daily_balances db
    JOIN usd_accounts a ON a.account_id = db.account_id
    WHERE db.balance_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY a.account_type
),

txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_type,
        COUNT(t.txn_id) AS txn_count
    FROM bank.transactions t
    JOIN usd_accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.posted_date >= DATE '2025-12-01'
      AND t.posted_date <  DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_type
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(b.account_type, tc.account_type) AS account_type,
    b.ending_balance,
    COALESCE(tc.txn_count, 0)                 AS txn_count
FROM balances b
FULL JOIN txn_counts tc ON tc.account_type = b.account_type
ORDER BY account_type

retail-fanout-04.sql:
WITH completed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
    FROM shop.orders o
    JOIN shop.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY c.segment
),
returned_units AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        SUM(r.quantity) AS total_units_returned
    FROM shop.returns r
    JOIN shop.order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    JOIN shop.orders o       ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN shop.customers c    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(co.segment, ru.segment)          AS segment,
    COALESCE(co.completed_order_count, 0)     AS completed_orders,
    COALESCE(ru.total_units_returned, 0)      AS units_returned
FROM completed_orders co
FULL OUTER JOIN returned_units ru ON co.segment = ru.segment
ORDER BY segment
